scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local keySources = {
	{ "ChaseWorld", "KeySpawns" },
	{ "ChaseSpots", "KeySpawns" },
}

local monsterList = {
	{
		Name = "ELI",
		Path = { "ChaseWorld", "Eli" },
		AnchorParts = { "Eli_Torso", "Eli_Head" },
		StateAttribute = "EliState",
		ChaseStates = { CHASE = true, HUNT = true, STALK = true, KILL = true },
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60),
	},
	{
		Name = "TWIN",
		Path = { "TwinEntity" },
		AnchorParts = { "Root" },
		StateAttribute = "State",
		ChaseStates = { chase = true, hunt = true, kill = true },
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 200),
	},
	{
		Name = "SCROW",
		Path = { "Scrow" },
		AnchorParts = { "Root" },
		StateAttribute = "State",
		ChaseStates = { chase = true, hunt = true },
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 120, 255),
	},
}

local monitorDistance = 60
local minActiveHeight = -50
local maxDrawDistance = 3000
local keyColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)
local keyLabelColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 90)
local arrowGlyph = "\226\158\156"

local keyModels = {}
local monsterModels = {}
local connections = {}
local espOn = true
local unloaded = false

local function walkPath(root, path)
	local node = root
	for _, segment in ipairs(path) do
		if node == nil then
			return nil
		end
		node = node:FindFirstChild(segment)
	end
	return node
end

local function getKeyPosition(model)
	local point = model:FindFirstChild("KeyPoint", true)
	if point and point:IsA("Attachment") then
		return point.WorldPosition
	end

	local mesh = model:FindFirstChild("KEY__key")
	if mesh and mesh:IsA("BasePart") then
		return mesh.Position
	end

	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			return d.Position
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function getMonsterPosition(model, anchorParts)
	for _, partName in ipairs(anchorParts) do
		local part = model:FindFirstChild(partName, true)
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			return part.Position
		end
	end

	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Transparency < 1 then
			return d.Position
		end
	end

	local root = model:FindFirstChild("RootPart") or model:FindFirstChild("Root")
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return root.Position
	end

	return nil
end

local function distanceFromPlayer(position)
	if position == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local character = localPlayer.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		return (root.Position - position).Magnitude
	end

	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then
		return (camera.CFrame.Position - position).Magnitude
	end

	return nil
end

local function readState(model, spec)
	if not spec.StateAttribute then
		return nil
	end

	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return model:GetAttribute(spec.StateAttribute)
	end)

	if ok and value ~= nil then
		return tostring(value)
	end

	return nil
end

local function isChasingState(state, spec)
	if not state then
		return false
	end

	local upper = string.upper(state)
	for chaseState in pairs(spec.ChaseStates) do
		if upper == string.upper(chaseState) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

local function buildArrow(color)
	local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	arrow.Name = "espArrow"
	arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	arrow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64)
	arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	arrow.TextSize = 46
	arrow.TextColor3 = color
	arrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	arrow.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	arrow.Text = arrowGlyph
	arrow.Visible = false
	arrow.Parent = playerGui
	return arrow
end

local function updateArrow(arrow, position, color)
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return
	end

	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
	if viewport.X <= 0 or viewport.Y <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local screenPoint, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)

	if onScreen and screenPoint.Z > 0 then
		local clampedX = math.clamp(screenPoint.X, 48, viewport.X - 48)
		local clampedY = math.clamp(screenPoint.Y, 48, viewport.Y - 48)

		if clampedX == screenPoint.X and clampedY == screenPoint.Y then
			arrow.Visible = false
			return
		end

		arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(clampedX, clampedY)
	else
		local relative = camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
		local flat = Vector2.new(relative.X, relative.Y)

		if flat.Magnitude < 1e-4 then
			flat = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		else
			flat = flat.Unit
		end

		if relative.Z > 0 then
			flat = -flat
		end

		local halfX = viewport.X / 2
		local halfY = viewport.Y / 2
		local scale = math.min(
			halfX / math.max(math.abs(flat.X), 1e-4),
			halfY / math.max(math.abs(flat.Y), 1e-4)
		)

		local projectedX = halfX + flat.X * scale
		local projectedY = halfY - flat.Y * scale

		arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
			math.clamp(projectedX, 48, viewport.X - 48),
			math.clamp(projectedY, 48, viewport.Y - 48)
		)
	end

	arrow.TextColor3 = color
	arrow.Visible = true
end

local function buildKeyEsp(model)
	if getKeyPosition(model) == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	highlight.Name = "keyEspHighlight"
	highlight.Adornee = model
	highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	highlight.FillColor = keyColor
	highlight.FillTransparency = 0.65
	highlight.OutlineColor = keyColor
	highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
	highlight.Parent = model

	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "keyEspLabel"
	gui.Adornee = model
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 22)
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0)
	gui.MaxDistance = maxDrawDistance
	gui.Parent = model

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Text"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextSize = 14
	label.TextColor3 = keyLabelColor
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	label.Text = "KEY"
	label.Parent = gui

	return {
		Model = model,
		Highlight = highlight,
		Gui = gui,
		Label = label,
		Arrow = buildArrow(keyColor),
	}
end

local function buildMonsterEsp(model, spec)
	if getMonsterPosition(model, spec.AnchorParts) == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	highlight.Name = "monsterEspHighlight"
	highlight.Adornee = model
	highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	highlight.FillColor = spec.Color
	highlight.FillTransparency = 0.85
	highlight.OutlineColor = spec.Color
	highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
	highlight.Parent = model

	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "monsterEspLabel"
	gui.Adornee = model
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 40)
	gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0)
	gui.MaxDistance = maxDrawDistance
	gui.Parent = model

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "Title"
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.6, 0)
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	title.TextSize = 17
	title.TextColor3 = spec.Color
	title.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	title.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	title.Text = spec.Name
	title.Parent = gui

	local subtitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	subtitle.Name = "Subtitle"
	subtitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	subtitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.58, 0)
	subtitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.42, 0)
	subtitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	subtitle.TextSize = 13
	subtitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 235)
	subtitle.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	subtitle.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	subtitle.Text = ""
	subtitle.Parent = gui

	return {
		Model = model,
		Spec = spec,
		Highlight = highlight,
		Gui = gui,
		Title = title,
		Subtitle = subtitle,
		Arrow = buildArrow(spec.Color),
	}
end

local function destroyEntry(entry)
	for _, inst in ipairs({ entry.Highlight, entry.Gui, entry.Arrow }) do
		if inst then
			inst:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function collectKeys()
	local found = {}

	for _, source in ipairs(keySources) do
		local container = walkPath(Workspace, source)
		if container then
			for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
				local key = child:FindFirstChild("Key")
				if key and key:IsA("Model") then
					table.insert(found, key)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return found
end

local function collectMonsters()
	local found = {}

	for _, spec in ipairs(monsterList) do
		local model = walkPath(Workspace, spec.Path)
		if model and model.Parent then
			local position = getMonsterPosition(model, spec.AnchorParts)
			if position and position.Y > minActiveHeight then
				table.insert(found, { Model = model, Spec = spec })
			end
		end
	end

	return found
end

local function syncEsp()
	if unloaded then
		return
	end

	local liveKeys = {}
	for _, model in ipairs(collectKeys()) do
		liveKeys[model] = true
		if not keyModels[model] then
			local ok, entry = pcall(buildKeyEsp, model)
			if ok and entry then
				keyModels[model] = entry
			end
		end
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(keyModels) do
		if not liveKeys[model] or not model.Parent then
			destroyEntry(entry)
			keyModels[model] = nil
		end
	end

	local liveMonsters = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(collectMonsters()) do
		liveMonsters[item.Model] = item.Spec
		if not monsterModels[item.Model] then
			local ok, entry = pcall(buildMonsterEsp, item.Model, item.Spec)
			if ok and entry then
				monsterModels[item.Model] = entry
			end
		end
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(monsterModels) do
		if not liveMonsters[model] or not model.Parent then
			destroyEntry(entry)
			monsterModels[model] = nil
		end
	end
end

local function updateKeyEsp(entry)
	local position = getKeyPosition(entry.Model)
	if position == nil then
		return
	end

	local distance = distanceFromPlayer(position)
	if distance then
		entry.Label.Text = "KEY  " .. tostring(math.floor(distance + 0.5)) .. "m"
	end

	if entry.Arrow then
		updateArrow(entry.Arrow, position, keyColor)
	end
end

local function updateMonsterEsp(entry)
	local position = getMonsterPosition(entry.Model, entry.Spec.AnchorParts)
	if position == nil then
		return
	end

	local distance = distanceFromPlayer(position)
	local state = readState(entry.Model, entry.Spec)
	local chasing = isChasingState(state, entry.Spec)
	local close = distance ~= nil and distance <= monitorDistance

	local color = entry.Spec.Color
	if close then
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
	elseif chasing then
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 0)
	end

	entry.Highlight.OutlineColor = color
	entry.Highlight.FillColor = color
	entry.Highlight.FillTransparency = close and 0.7 or 0.85
	entry.Title.TextColor3 = color
	entry.Title.Text = close and (entry.Spec.Name .. "  !!") or entry.Spec.Name

	local info = {}
	if state then
		table.insert(info, string.upper(state))
	end
	if distance then
		table.insert(info, tostring(math.floor(distance + 0.5)) .. "m")
	end
	if close then
		table.insert(info, "CLOSE")
	end
	entry.Subtitle.Text = table.concat(info, "  ")

	if entry.Arrow then
		updateArrow(entry.Arrow, position, color)
	end
end

local function setEspVisible(visible)
	espOn = visible

	for _, entry in pairs(keyModels) do
		entry.Highlight.Enabled = visible
		entry.Gui.Enabled = visible
		if not visible and entry.Arrow then
			entry.Arrow.Visible = false
		end
	end

	for _, entry in pairs(monsterModels) do
		entry.Highlight.Enabled = visible
		entry.Gui.Enabled = visible
		if not visible and entry.Arrow then
			entry.Arrow.Visible = false
		end
	end
end

local function unloadEsp()
	if unloaded then
		return
	end

	unloaded = true
	espOn = false

	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)

	for model, entry in pairs(keyModels) do
		destroyEntry(entry)
		keyModels[model] = nil
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(monsterModels) do
		destroyEntry(entry)
		monsterModels[model] = nil
	end
end

table.insert(connections, Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
	task.defer(syncEsp)
end))

table.insert(connections, Workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function()
	task.defer(syncEsp)
end))

table.insert(connections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if unloaded then
		return
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(keyModels) do
		if model.Parent then
			pcall(updateKeyEsp, entry)
		else
			destroyEntry(entry)
			keyModels[model] = nil
		end
	end

	for model, entry in pairs(monsterModels) do
		if model.Parent then
			pcall(updateMonsterEsp, entry)
		else
			destroyEntry(entry)
			monsterModels[model] = nil
		end
	end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed or unloaded then
		return
	end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
		setEspVisible(not espOn)
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
		unloadEsp()
	end
end))

task.spawn(function()
	while not unloaded do
		task.wait(0.75)
		pcall(syncEsp)
	end
end)

syncEsp()

scripts.features:
Axon Hub for Huss Valley combines Auto Cross, Auto Catch, Auto Dodge, gem collection, and detailed ESP. Customize runner and catcher automation, manage your equipment, claim available rewards, and track your progress from one organized menu.

AUTO CROSS & GEM FARM

- Auto Cross — run toward the opposite safe zone while steering around obstacles and nearby catchers.
- Auto Collect Gems — collect gems along your crossing route with adjustable detour and danger limits.
- Full Auto Steering — optionally let crossing and collection continue while movement keys are pressed.
- Auto Dodge — react to incoming dives, stabs, and lunges.
- Bait Jukes — bait nearby catchers into attacking before dodging and continuing.
- Auto Dash on Turn — trigger a dash when making sharp turns.
- Dodge Bowling Balls and steer around Banana Peels.

AUTO CATCH & CHASE

- Auto Catch — automatically stab when a runner is within range and a hit is predicted.
- Smart Stab — wait for a confirmed target before attacking.
- Auto Dive — time dives using runner movement, distance, and obstacles.
- Auto Chase — pursue an interception point ahead of your target.
- Aim Lock — follow the target’s predicted direction with your camera.
- Customize targeting and add your own stab and dive keybinds.

ABILITIES & RESCUE

- Auto Clone and Auto Ghost when the required weapon is equipped.
- Auto Runner Ability — activate supported equipped abilities when useful.
- Auto Use Items — use equipped items according to nearby threats.
- Auto Self-Revive — use an equipped Rescue Kit when available.
- Auto Rescue — revive nearby downed teammates, with optional movement toward them.
- Catcher equipment automation for Leash, Bowling Ball, Rocket Shoes, Big Dagger, and Adrenaline.
- Equipment features respect available charges and cooldowns.

ESP & WARNINGS

- Player ESP with names, distance, roles, dash status, and catcher cooldowns.
- Gem ESP, Gem Tracers, and pickup range indicators.
- Hazard ESP and Downed Teammate ESP.
- Fake Runner identification and cloaked-player highlighting.
- Catcher warnings, Threat Radar, and target safe-zone indicators.
- Customize colors, display styles, range, and enemy-only filtering.

REWARDS & EQUIPMENT

- Auto claim eligible Journey, Daily Quest, and Event rewards.
- Auto Spin using available spin credits.
- Auto Open selected knife crates with gems and a configurable reserve.
- Auto Equip your best owned perk knife.
- Auto restock selected items with stock targets and coin reserves.
- Maintain your selected unlocked abilities and item loadout.

MATCH TOOLS & EXTRAS

- Stay in Matches, Auto Vote Map, Auto Hero Choice, and Auto Pick Runner.
- Automatically close match summaries and dismiss reward popups.
- Server Hop, low-player-count Auto Hop, and Rejoin.
- Spectator tools, Free Camera, and adjustable field of view.
- FPS optimization and camera customization.
- Discord webhook alerts for crate drops, rare knives, level-ups, rewards, and match results.
- Periodic session summaries and saved configurations.
